title: Spiced Chickpea Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from the Middle East, made with spiced chickpeas and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion, ginger, and garlic and cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and salt. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chickpeas, honey (if using), and 1 cup of water. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the chickpeas are tender.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley or cilantro) if desired.
